m-xylene (1,3-dimethylbenzene, CAS 108-38-3):

- **Critical temperature:** Tc = 617.0 K (343.9 °C)
- **Critical pressure:** Pc = 3.541 MPa (35.41 bar)
- **Acentric factor:** ω = 0.326 to 0.331. ω = 0.326 is the CoolProp/HEOS value. The value from its definition, ω = −log10(Psat/Pc) − 1 at T = 0.7 Tc, is 0.3264.

I didn't take these from memory. I looked them up in the Python `chemicals` library (installed with pip into the session), which collects several independent data sources. The experimental sources agree closely:

| Source | Tc (K) | Pc (MPa) | ω |
|---|---|---|---|
| IUPAC | 617.0 | 3.541 | n/a |
| CRC Handbook | 616.9 | 3.540 | n/a |
| CoolProp (HEOS) | 616.89 | 3.5346 | 0.326 |
| NIST WebBook | 618.0 | 3.536 | n/a |
| Yaws | 617.0 | 3.541 | 0.327 |
| PSRK / Poling (Properties of Gases and Liquids) | 617.0 / 617.05 | 3.546 / 3.541 | 0.331 / 0.3311 |

Group-contribution estimates (Joback, Wilson-Jasperson) give a higher Tc of about 625 K and a Pc of about 3.59 to 3.62 MPa. I left them out of the recommended values. No files were created.
